en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet residential street lined with wooden houses featuring steep gabled roofs and decorative trim. A dirt road curves to the left, bordered by white picket fences and hedges. Several people, including children with a handcart, are seen along the fence in the foreground. Trees and gardens surround the homes. In the upper left corner, a printed caption reads "Parti fra Elverum."
